## Summary

Clearly describe the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Motivation

- What problem does this solve?
- How does it help the House/Galaxy/Cranium architecture?
- How does it respect GPU sovereignty and procedural-first memory?

## Proposed Design

Describe your proposed approach. When possible, reference existing specs and components.

- Relevant specs (e.g., `docs/ROADMAP.md`, `docs/HOUSE_GALAXY_TABLET.md`, `SOVEREIGN_SWARM_BRIEFING.md`):
- Existing kernels / bridges to reuse or extend:
- New modules or files you expect to touch:

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative designs or approaches you considered and why you are not choosing them.

## Impact

Check all that apply:

- [ ] Cranium kernels / PTX
- [ ] Galaxy memory / k-NN / resonance
- [ ] House GLB / Memory Tablet UX
- [ ] Viewer / UI / accessibility
- [ ] Ingestion / training pipelines
- [ ] Docs only

## Additional Context

Add any other context, sketches, links, or references that help explain the feature. If this idea continues a previous TEMP session or partner contribution, link to those notes as well.
